name: @jeswr/site-model
description: Semantic agent browser: the RDF site model (actions a website offers, mapped to its own HTTP calls) and its typed projection.

scripts.build: pnpm -w exec tsc -p packages/site-model/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs
scripts.codegen: node node_modules/@jeswr/federation-codegen/dist/cli.js gen --ontology site-action.ttl --shapes codegen/site-action.codegen.shacl.ttl --config codegen.config.json --out src/generated
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -w exec tsc -p packages/site-model/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm -w exec tsc -p packages/site-model/tsconfig.test.json
